name: NOAA NCEI Access Data Service

provider.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

summary: Keyless API for station-based climate observations from NOAA NCEI archives, such as GHCN-Daily daily summaries, as JSON or CSV.
description: The Access Data Service v1 subsets NCEI datasets by station, date range, data type, bounding box and units. Datasets include daily-summaries (GHCN-Daily), global-summary-of-the-month and global-summary-of-the-year, and other station datasets listed in the docs. A companion Search Service lists the datasets and supports faceted lookup.

endpoints.summary: Subset a dataset by station, date range and data types
Search Service: list and facet the available datasets

license.name: NOAA open data (US Government work); no licence text found on the docs page

coverage.geographic: Global, station-based (daily-summaries covers land stations worldwide, densest in the US)
coverage.temporal: Varies by dataset and station; some daily records go back well over a century

agent_notes: Station ids are GHCN ids (USW00094728 is New York Central Park); find them in the Search Service or the NCEI station finder. Always pass dataTypes, units and format=json; values come back as strings. Request narrow date ranges per call. Add includeStationName=true to get names without a second lookup.
caveats: Values are returned as strings, and in daily-summaries missing observations are simply absent.
Data types and units depend on the dataset; metric units are only a request option for some datasets.
No OpenAPI spec found, and the rate limits and licence are not documented on the user guide page.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; CORS * on the example.
